correctness.rationale: PASS. Read the actual RESULT.md and verification code by their frozen Git blob SHA. The directed BEST and Matrix–Tree theorems give q^(q-2)((q-1)!)^q cyclic Euler tours; simultaneous contraction of two vertex-b turns with four distinct edges changes the factorial by 1/((q-1)(q-2)). The rooted Laplacian rank-two update leads to J=[q^2-q(2+x+y)+x+y+xy-u-v-uv]/[q^2(q-1)(q-2)]; a single shortcut gives p_abc=(q-1-x)/[q(q-1)]. Injective partial-match constraints on (a,d) and (c,e) leave only 0,1,direct-2,crossed-2 matches. Subtraction gives precisely the four listed covariance fractions, with their feasible q cutoffs; crossed becomes 0 at q=5 and >0 from q=6. An independently authored enumeration of Euler successor permutations checked all 24 and 20736 cyclic tours at q=3,4 and all corresponding ordered motifs against the joint formula. Those finite enumerations support, but do not establish, the all-q algebraic theorem.
